record.context_brief: remove lower bound in Hermitian stability theorem
record.original_question: In Theorem 4.3 for Hermitian Monge-Ampere equations, u and v are continuous omega-plurisubharmonic solutions with right-hand sides f and g in L^p, and the stability estimate ||u - v||_infty <= C ||f - g||_p^alpha is proved under the extra assumption f >= c_0 > 0. Determine whether that lower-bound assumption on f can be removed.

evidence.quote: Theorem 4.3 (Kolodziej-Nguyen). ... Assume moreover that f >= c0 for some c0 > 0. Then ||u - v||_infty <= C ||f - g||_p^alpha ... Question 32 (Kolodziej-Nguyen). Can one remove the condition f >= c0 > 0 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Hermitian manifold of complex dimension $n$, where $\omega$ is a smooth positive $(1,1)$-form (not necessarily closed). A function $u \colon X \to \mathbb{R}\cup\{-\infty\}$ is called $\omega$-plurisubharmonic ($\omega$-psh) if $u$ is upper semicontinuous, $u\not\equiv -\infty$, and $\omega + dd^c u \ge 0$ as a current. For continuous $\omega$-psh functions $u$ the complex Monge–Ampère measure $(\omega+dd^c u)^n$ is well defined.

Fix $p>1$. Suppose $u, v$ are continuous $\omega$-psh functions on $X$ satisfying
$$(\omega+dd^c u)^n = f\,\omega^n, \qquad (\omega+dd^c v)^n = g\,\omega^n,$$
with $f,g \in L^p(X,\omega^n)$ nonnegative and $\int_X f\,\omega^n = \int_X g\,\omega^n$, and a normalization fixing the additive constants (e.g. $\sup_X(u-v) = \sup_X(v-u)$).

It is known that there exist constants $C>0$ and $\alpha\in(0,1)$, depending only on $(X,\omega)$, $p$, and uniform $L^p$-bounds on $f,g$, such that
$$\|u - v\|_{L^\infty(X)} \le C\,\|f-g\|_{L^p(X,\omega^n)}^{\alpha},$$
under the additional hypothesis that $f \ge c_0$ on $X$ for some constant $c_0 > 0$.

Question: Does the stability estimate above continue to hold without the strict positivity assumption $f \ge c_0 > 0$, i.e. for arbitrary nonnegative $f,g \in L^p$ with the same total mass?
artifact.category_tag: complex Monge-Ampère equations on Hermitian manifolds
artifact.status_search_result: The lower-bound assumption $f\ge c_0>0$ in the Kołodziej–Nguyen Hermitian stability theorem appears to have been removed by Lu, Phung, and Tô (arXiv:2003.08417, published in Annales de l'Institut Fourier 71 (2021)), who establish stability and Hölder regularity for solutions of complex Monge–Ampère equations on compact Hermitian manifolds with $L^p$ right-hand side ($p>1$) without requiring nondegeneracy of $f$.

status_evidence.title: Stability and Hölder regularity of solutions to complex Monge-Ampère equations on compact Hermitian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: We establish a stability result for solutions to complex Monge-Ampère equations with right-hand side in L^p, p>1, and prove that the solutions are Hölder continuous with the same exponent as in the Kähler case.
status_evidence.claim: Lu–Phung–Tô prove L^p stability and Hölder regularity on compact Hermitian manifolds, addressing the question of removing the c_0 > 0 condition.

status_evidence.title: Stability and Hölder regularity of solutions to complex Monge–Ampère equations on compact Hermitian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Annales de l'Institut Fourier, Volume 71 (2021) no. 5, pp. 2019-2045.
status_evidence.claim: Published version of the Lu–Phung–Tô stability theorem without the strict positivity hypothesis on the density.

status_evidence.title: Stability and regularity of solutions of the Monge-Ampère equation on Hermitian manifolds (Kołodziej–Nguyen)
status_evidence.snippet: Stability of solutions of the complex Monge-Ampère equation on compact Hermitian manifolds, when the right hand side varies in a bounded set in L^p, p>1 and is bounded away from zero.
status_evidence.claim: The original Kołodziej–Nguyen result requires the right-hand side to be bounded away from zero.
